observations: Five identical retail boxes for a portable power bank.
The Xiaomi logo is visible in the top right corner of each box.
Text on the boxes reads 'Xiaomi Power Bank 10000mAh Integrated Cable'.
The product image on the box shows '165W MAX' printed on the device.
A watermark 'CHIBEN GADGETS' is present across the center of the image.
The boxes appear to be in a retail or warehouse environment.

claims.evidence: The brand logo and model specifications are clearly printed on the retail packaging in photo 0.
Performance and charging speeds cannot be verified through a photo of the packaging.

risks.risk: The item may be a counterfeit or clone, which is common for Xiaomi power banks.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the anti-counterfeit scratch-off label on the back of the box.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic or clone unit

risks.risk: The internal battery cells may be dead or have significantly reduced capacity (DOA).
risks.proof: A video showing the power bank charging a device and its own digital display functioning.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the box showing the security/authenticity scratch code.
Photo of the box seals to confirm they are factory-sealed and new.
Video of one unit powered on and charging a mobile device.
response.reason: The product is clearly identified by its retail packaging as a specific Xiaomi model. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional/unverified authenticity) pending further proof.
